Taskle (タスクル) is a team timeboxing task manager built for non-engineers.

Primary audience:
- Japanese SMEs, sales teams, and non-technical teams

Core capabilities:
- Timeboxing: tasks become calendar blocks automatically
- Team visibility: progress is visible in real time
- Assignment clarity: owners and deadlines are explicit
- Calendar-based tasking: plan by time, not just lists

Key URLs:
- https://www.taskle.ink/
- https://www.taskle.ink/blog
- https://www.taskle.ink/vision
